caption: The drawing contains several objects arranged on an off-white background. In the upper left quadrant, there is an elongated, cylindrical, and slightly curved object depicted in grayscale, with a darkened, rounded tip and a lighter body; three fine lines extend from its lower end, curving across the page toward the bottom right. In the lower right quadrant, the three lines connect to a large, oval, symmetrical form shaded in brown with a central vertical light gray band that has two small circles near its middle. In the upper right quadrant, there is a rectangular inset, inside which are several simplified, parallel, and segmented lines, along with outlined forms and a bifurcated figure at the edge; these are drawn in pencil and are lighter than the shaded forms elsewhere on the page. The composition is organized primarily within a large, faintly outlined square, with the main forms distinctly separated and labeled in small print at the lower edge.
title: Pinball and Chain
